notes: Two taḥwīl branches; «قالا حدثنا ابن عون» («قالا» = Muadh and Azhar) is written once after the last taḥwīl, so the tail belongs to both.
«أبو رجاء، مولى أبي قلابة عن أبي قلابة» makes Abu Qilaba the narrator of the story (occurrence 2 of «أبي قلابة»; the first is inside «مولى أبي قلابة»).
Anbasa speaks in the story and cites Anas («قد حدثنا أنس بن مالك»). Whether Anas or Anbasa is a further last link (rule 6) is not settled, so neither is added and needs_ruling is set.
